glosses: Criado de librea, cuya principal ocupación es acompañar a su amo a pie, a caballo o en coche.

Lazo colgante de cintas con que adornaban las mujeres el puño de la camisa o del jubón.

A strong vertical post of timber or iron, fixed to the ground and/or on the deck of a ship, to which the ship's mooring lines etc are secured.

examples.text: Today he had for bollard the unfinished monument half-erected to some all but forgotten anarchist.
He sat on a bollard, looking out across the water, a man more small and shabby than expected.

glosses: A similar post preventing vehicle access to a pedestrian area, to delineate traffic lanes, or used for security purposes.
